stemBlocks: A sound wave is produced by a loudspeaker cone, which creates pulses of pressure by moving back and forth between two points $X$ and $Y$ as shown in the diagram.

The distance between points $X$ and $Y$ is $5.0 \text{ mm}$ and the loudspeaker produces pulses of high pressure every $0.20 \text{ milliseconds}$. The following statements about the sound wave produced are made: P It has a speed of $25 \text{ ms}^{-1}$. Q It has an amplitude of $5.0 \text{ mm}$. R It has a wavelength of $5.5 \text{ mm}$. S It has a frequency of $5.0 \text{ kHz}$. Which of these statements can be correctly deduced from the information given?
